g: and you will divide into three
and you will do three times
and they did a third time
and he will cause to rejoice
and I will make rejoice them
and I will make glad them
and he has caused to rejoice
and they will be made desolate
so I may make hear them
so he may make hear us
and he will cause to hear
I will cause to hear you
so I may make hear you
so they may cause to hear
